attackers_goals: Use an account that has access to resources to move laterally in the network and access privileged resources.
description: A machine account performed an interactive or remote interactive login.
investigative_actions: See whether the login was successful. Check whether the account has done any administrative actions it should not usually do. Look for more logins and authentications by the account throughout the network.
name: Interactive login by a machine account

variations.name: Successful interactive login by a machine account
variations.description: A machine account performed a successful interactive or remote interactive login.
